rhea: heads up — hit an onboarding snag in samplekit where fncall/toolcall + jsonMode + auth-refresh yields nested quoted JSON. app-level schema validators choke.

matt: can you paste the minimal trace? even a few lines helps.

rhea: simplified trace: RUNTIME->tool returns "{\"users\": [\"alice\"]}"; auth refresh triggers; retry -> client receives "\"{\\\"users\\\": [\\\"alice\\\"]}\"" (double-quoted). app expects object, gets string.

yara: we keep hitting parity issues: node SDK had a top-level tryParse helper so some apps unblocked, python didn't.

kevin: proposal: add a small, idempotent normalizer in SDK cores: `coerceStructuredOutput(value, {jsonMode, contentType, strictJsonMode})` that returns native types when appropriate and never double-quotes. also remove any `JSON.stringify` mutations inside retry logging — logging must not mutate response payload.

matt: +1. tests: unit tests for idempotence (normalize(normalize(x)) === normalize(x)), and CI e2e that simulates token expiry mid-call with tools that return JSON-as-string.

rhea: I'll add a short note in samplekit README under "Known fncall edgecases" pointing to the tracker issue so new users don't waste hours.

opsbot: Created INF-5102: "Introduce coerceStructuredOutput + make retry idempotent for JSON-string tool outputs" assigned to @kevin. Priority: P2. https://tracker.redwood/infr/INF-5102

yara: temporary mitigation for apps: use a tiny helper in app code to defensively unquote top-level strings: `function safeUnwrap(x){ if (typeof x==='string') try{return JSON.parse(x);}catch{return x} return x }`. add it around fields you expect to be structured.

kevin: action items I'll take: (1) implement `coerceStructuredOutput` in node & go SDKs, (2) strip mutation in retry logging, (3) add samplekit smoke test + CI e2e, (4) update samplekit README & onboarding note. will coordinate simultaneous minor SDK releases.

matt: consider adding `strictJsonMode: boolean` flag to SDK config so teams that want strict type errors can opt in and get explicit failures instead of silent coercion. document in samplekit YAML.

rhea: thanks — leaving repro logs & a minimal failing test in INF-5102. ping me if you want me to attach a reproducible sample. :rocket:
